title: ‘Pagod na ako sa kanila’: Sara Duterte won’t endorse senatorial bets in 2028 polls
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte on Fruday said she would no longer endorse any senatorial candidate should she run for the presidency in the 2028 elections.
